title: The Feedback Tone Matcher
description: Helps a faculty member calibrate written feedback on student work — paste your draft and a sample of how you usually write, get suggestions that match your voice.
framing_paragraph: This recipe defines The Feedback Tone Matcher, a teaching-focused agent that fits the use case in the description above. Use it when that description matches what you want the agent to do in your course. The agent works best when its Instructions field is calibrated against two or three representative prompts before you share the resulting agent with students or colleagues.
